verdict.rationale: The Kimi API Platform publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its inference API (chat completions, responses, messages, batches, files, models). It also publishes a separate OpenAPI Admin API spec, and both download without authentication, which directly delivers a machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec downloads and validates, and clarity on coverage, since a probe notes the spec belongs to the separate Open Platform product and the assistant app itself has no public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Moonshot AI API", "API for Moonshot AI / Kimi large language model services", server https://api.moonshot.ai
